classification.reason: Clicking e1-2 selects it and moves it after e1-3 in the shared SVG; the subsequent :first assertion reads unselected e1-3. Documented shared-SVG ordering: research/traces/edge-visibility-stacking.md:34.
Clicking the first e1-2 path selects it, then shared-SVG selected elevation moves it after unselected e1-3, which becomes :first. Documented ordering: research/traces/edge-visibility-stacking.md:34.

before.reason: The native click selects e1-2, but elevation reorders wrappers so :first becomes unselected e1-3; the first-wrapper assertion fails.
The native click selects e1-2, but elevation reorders wrappers so :first becomes unselected e1-3.

Forced subject events select e1-2, but it moves after e1-3, so the :first assertion reads unselected e1-3. Interaction never enables edge elevation; ignoring the default-false elevation policy is not covered by the documented Basic shared-SVG exception.

Forced pointer down/up and click reach e1-2 with selection enabled, but its wrapper stays unselected. The earlier UP-127-048 pan put the release point offscreen, where elementsFromPoint returns no hit; forced activation and native hit testing remain separate boundaries.
The control zoom-out and double-click factors cancel, leaving the final CSS transform equal to the synchronously captured pre-queue value after the upstream 50ms wait.
